name: TIC 55558013
description: A red giant observed by TESS, 10.5 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,063 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.93 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,673 K at its surface.
